title: Privometry detector pack manifest v1
description: pack.yaml at the root of a detector pack folder. The folder also holds detectors/*.yaml (privometry.detectors/v1) and README.md. Detector packs use the same layout, signing and trust model as rule packs, but hold detectors instead of rules: detectors run in the Go extractors and produce policy facts and content findings; Cedar only sees the facts. A pack whose samples do not all pass cannot be released. Strict.

id.description: <publisher>/<name>, for example privometry/credentials. Detectors are referenced as <id>:<detector-id> in content_finding.detector_id.

version.description: A new detector or a wider pattern is a minor change; removing a detector or narrowing what it finds is a major change.

min_sensor_version.description: Oldest sensor that supports every detector kind and option the pack uses.

categories.description: Every detector's category must be listed here; the pack test runner checks this.
